specs.verified_mechanism: Script ZZ1_AnalystValue_AOP_PredictedFE_IntrinsicValue.py builds its panel from the FULL SignalMasterTable (L91-92: permno, tickerIBES, time_avail_m, prc), LEFT-joins monthlyCRSP shrout (L96-101) and m_aCompustat (L104-122), computes SG=sale/shift(60) positionally over SMT monthly rows (L127-131), filters to June (L133), LEFT-joins the May-statement IBES froe1/froe2/ltg on tickerIBES (L138-142), then l12_ceq = shift(1) positionally over the June rows per permno (L156-161) so ceq_ave=(ceq+prior_June_ceq)/2 (L163-172); screens L252-261; expands each June row to months +0..+11 (L449-461) with NO re-check of SMT at those months. The engine kernel _prepare_analyst_value_signals (p1_factor_engine.py L1519-1640) instead INNER-merges _ibes_permno_month_map with monthlyCRSP and m_aCompustat (L1554-1558), so its June panel starts only when IBES-link coverage starts and shift(1) for l12_ceq (L1567) misses the true prior June -> ceq_ave collapses to ceq. Sampled-cell proof: permno 10161 June-1976 (feps1=4.06, feps2=4.37, no LTG): recomputation with script ceq_ave=(1363.0+940.43)/2=1151.715 gives AnalystValue=0.63636212 == oracle 0.63636214; recomputation with engine ceq_ave=ceq=1363.0 gives 0.6227887 == native 0.6227887. Extras (95,430 cells) are engine link-and-CRSP June-expanded permno-months absent from SignalMasterTable; misses (372) are SMT June rows dropped by the engine's inner merges.

specs.verified_mechanism: Script BM.py: m_aCompustat[ceqt,datadate] RIGHT-merged onto SignalMasterTable mve_permco (L39, frame = SMT rows), me_datadate = POSITIONAL groupby(permno).mve_permco.shift(6) kept only where the positional 6-back month equals the datadate month (L51-59), unlimited ffill per permno (L62), BM = log(ceqt/me_datadate) (L71); output = SMT rows with BM non-null. The remaining 1,436 divergent cells are purely the script's positional shift(6) misfiring across SMT listing gaps. Sampled-cell proof: permno 26569 June-1969 (May-1969 missing from SMT): script positional l6t=1968-11 != datadate 1968-12 -> match fails -> oracle carries stale frozen me=188.104 -> BM=0.336218 == oracle; engine calendar lag6 = mve(1968-12)=268.52 matches datadate -> BM=log(263.279/268.52)=-0.019711 == native. specs.verified_mechanism: Script BrandInvest.py: on a_aCompustat sorted by (gvkey,fyear), BrandCapital initialized 0 for ALL rows (L91), seed xad/0.6 written at the first non-missing-xad row (L79), then the recursion BC[i]=0.5*BC[i-1]+tempxad[i] runs for i in range(1,len(gvkey)) UNCONDITIONALLY (L104-112) - so whenever the first non-missing xad is NOT the gvkey's first row, the seed is overwritten by 0.5*0+tempxad = xad (effective seed = xad, not 1.667*xad); afterwards rows with fyear<FirstNMyear or xad NaN are set NaN (L116-119), BC/=at plain division (L122), BrandInvest = xad0/groupby(gvkey).BC.shift(1) (L125-126), sic 4900-4999 and 6000-6999 dropped, December-datadate rows only, expand 12 months, dedup (gvkey,time keep last) then (permno,time keep first). Engine kernel _op_brand_invest_signal (p1_factor_engine.py L1734-1786) instead starts the recursion at first_pos+1 preserving the xad/0.6 seed (L1748-1752) and divides by at with a masked np.divide that returns NaN where at==0 (L1754-1759). Sampled-cell proof (IBM permno 12490, first non-missing xad at position 34, fyear 1984, xad=538): script-style recursion (zeros init, seed overwritten) gives BrandInvest for the fyear-1995 row (held at 1996-06) = 101122.6204 == oracle 101122.62; engine-style seed-preserved gives 101086.3998 == native 101086.40; fyear-1996 row: 73767.947 vs 73760.383, both matching their sides. Difference decays as 0.5^k after the seed year, hitting every gvkey whose xad history starts after its Compustat history (141,461 cells).
specs.kernel_patch: In _op_brand_invest_signal: replace the seed/recursion block with the script's exact semantics: brand_capital = np.zeros(len(group)); if first_pos == 0: brand_capital[0] = xad.iloc[0]/0.6; for i in range(1, len(group)): brand_capital[i] = 0.5*brand_capital[i-1] + tempxad[i]  (equivalently: keep writing the xad/0.6 seed at first_pos but let the unconditional i-from-1 recursion overwrite it whenever first_pos > 0 - the seed only survives when the gvkey's very first row has non-missing xad). Then brand_capital[:first_pos] = NaN (fyear < FirstNMyear) and brand_capital[~ok] = NaN as now. Also replace the masked np.divide by PLAIN division brand_capital/at (script emits inf when at==0 and BC!=0; downstream xad0/inf -> 0.0 rows must survive). Everything else (shift(1) after masking, sic filter, December-datadate filter, 12-month expansion, dedup order) is already script-identical - keep. Document the overwritten-seed behavior as an oracle quirk (Stata sequential replace) deliberately matched.
specs.expected_residual: Exact pass expected: the annual recursion, lag and dedup all operate on the same a_aCompustat (gvkey,fyear) frame as the script; the pre-existing ~580 inf cells (at==0 chains) are identical on both sides.

specs.verified_mechanism: Script CBOperProf.py: SignalMasterTable[permno,gvkey,time_avail_m,exchcd,sicCRSP,shrcd,mve_permco,mve_c] LEFT-merged with m_aCompustat (L65, frame = ALL SMT rows); the 11 vars revt,cogs,xsga,xrd,rect,invt,xpp,drc,drlt,ap,xacc zero-filled ON THE MERGED SMT FRAME (L87-88 - zeros on SMT rows only, this script never gap-fills); 12-month lags are CALENDAR (self-merge on permno and t-12mo within the SMT frame, L95-105: lag is NaN when t-12 is not an SMT row, else the zero-filled value); CBOperProf = (revt-cogs-(xsga-xrd)) - d12(rect) - d12(invt) - d12(xpp) + (drc+drlt-l12drc-l12drlt) + d12(ap) + d12(xacc), all /at (L118-129); then NaN where shrcd>11 | mve_c missing | BM=log(ceq/mve_permco) missing | at missing | 6000<=sicCRSP<7000 (L131-144, note: code gates on mve_c though the comment says mve_permco). Engine tree is plain (revt-cogs-fillna(xsga,0))/at with NONFINANCIAL_ONLY on Compustat sic - wrong formula, wrong fill domain, no shrcd/mve_c/BM gates, wrong sic source. Sampled-cell proof: IBM permno 12490 2000-01: full script replication = 0.08002323 == oracle 0.08002323; native 0.15840882 == plain (revt-cogs-xsga)/at. Data facts verified: SMT shrcd is never NaN (10: 953,877; 11: 2,852,606; 12: 241,147 rows - the shrcd gate strips all shrcd=12 rows) and sicCRSP is never NaN on SMT rows.
specs.new_tree_python: SMT_OUT(ADD(O("nonfinancial_only", DIV(ADD(SUB(SUB(zf_revt, zf_cogs), SUB(zf_xsga, zf_xrd)), MUL(C(-1.0), DELTA(zf_rect, 12)), MUL(C(-1.0), DELTA(zf_invt, 12)), MUL(C(-1.0), DELTA(zf_xpp, 12)), DELTA(ADD(zf_drc, zf_drlt), 12), DELTA(zf_ap, 12), DELTA(zf_xacc, 12)), at), m_siccrsp), MUL(C(0.0), NEGATIVE_TO_NULL(SUB(C(11.0), m_shrcd))), MUL(C(0.0), m_mve_c), MUL(C(0.0), NEGATIVE_TO_NULL(DIV(ceq, m_mve)))))  # with small inline aliases zf_<v> = O("smt_fill", V("m_aCompustat.parquet", "<v>"), value=0.0) for v in {revt,cogs,xsga,xrd,rect,invt,xpp,drc,drlt,ap,xacc}; at/ceq/m_siccrsp/m_shrcd/m_mve/m_mve_c/SMT_OUT are existing _manual_trees aliases. Semantics: smt_fill zero-fills exactly the script's fill domain (SMT rows only, gap months NaN) so DELTA's calendar LAG(12) reproduces the script's t-12 self-merge (NaN when t-12 not in SMT); the C(0.0)-gates add 0 when the condition holds and NaN otherwise: NEGATIVE_TO_NULL(11-shrcd) keeps shrcd<=11 and nulls shrcd=12; MUL(C(0.0), m_mve_c) requires mve_c non-missing; NEGATIVE_TO_NULL(ceq/mve_permco) requires log(ceq/mve_permco) defined (ratio>=0, non-null); nonfinancial_only(x, sicCRSP) excludes 6000<=sicCRSP<7000 using CRSP sic, matching the script.

Sampled proofs: (permno 48397, 1974-05): gvkey 1465 has group rdq=1974-05-01 (size 3, cheq 0/atq 3554.683) and SINGLETON rdq=1974-05-15 (56.038/3562.808); native=0.015728606=56.038/3562.808 (singleton wins as newest rdq), oracle=0.0=0/3554.683 (singleton dropped, older window still open). (53911, 1975-08): singleton rdq=1975-08-25 -> native 1.233/16.508=0.074691 vs oracle group rdq=1975-08-13 -> 0.703/17.783=0.039532. Extra cell (44580, 1972-02): the only announcement is singleton rdq=1972-02-25 -> native 1.623/39.664=0.040919, oracle emits nothing. specs.verified_mechanism: Script ChInvIA.py L35 inner-joins SignalMasterTable with m_aCompustat, then computes ALL lags (ppent_l12 L49-53, capx_l12 L60-65, capx_l24 L67-72) via calendar self-merges ON THAT MERGED PANEL — so a lag is NaN whenever the firm was outside the SMT universe at the lag month, even if m_aCompustat has data there. The engine tree's firm-level pchcapx (guards, coalesce fallback, capx->delta(ppent,12) fill) is already correct, but its LAG/DELTA run on the FULL m_aCompustat wide grid and only the final pchcapx is smt_only-masked, so lag values leak in from non-SMT months. Proven at the max-divergence cell (1996-07, permno 10119, sic2=63): script group mean over 125 valid firms = 8.863084066665196e15/125 = 7.09047e13 (dominated by permno 75529 whose avg_lag_capx = 0.5*(-0.447+0.447) = -2.78e-17 float dust, not exactly 0, giving pchcapx=8.863e15 in BOTH implementations); engine mean = same sum/126 = 7.0341937037025e13 which equals native -7.034194e13 exactly. The 126th member is permno 75073: engine pchcapx=-1.0 built from m_aCompustat capx at 1995-07/1994-07 where 75073 has NO SignalMasterTable rows (verified: SMT row exists 1996-07 only); the script's merged-panel lag lookup returns NaN there, excluding it from the mean and the output (also explains the 5,346 extra-in-native cells; 951,014 both-divergent cells are the shifted industry means). Full-panel simulation: pchcapx recomputed with SMT-masked inputs (capx/ppent .where(SMT) before all shifts) matches the script's pchcapx on EVERY cell — 0 divergent, 0 missing, 0 extra. SMT sicCRSP is int16 with 0 NaN so the script's 'na' sic2D group never arises; _op_industry_adjusted_mean's isfinite filter is a no-op given the ZERO_TO_NULL guards.
specs.new_tree_python:
capx_smt = O("smt_only", capx)
ppent_smt = O("smt_only", ppent)
capx_filled_smt = O("coalesce", capx_smt, DELTA(ppent_smt, 12))
avg_lag_capx_smt = AVG(LAG(capx_filled_smt, 12), LAG(capx_filled_smt, 24))
pchcapx_smt = O(
    "coalesce",
    DIV(SUB(capx_filled_smt, avg_lag_capx_smt), ZERO_TO_NULL(avg_lag_capx_smt)),
    DIV(SUB(capx_filled_smt, LAG(capx_filled_smt, 12)), ZERO_TO_NULL(LAG(capx_filled_smt, 12))),
)
"ChInvIA": O("industry_adjusted_mean", pchcapx_smt, m_siccrsp)

specs.expected_residual: exact pass (0 divergent cells) — the SMT-masked-input pchcapx was verified cell-identical to the script's pchcapx over the whole panel, so industry means and output support coincide; float-dust denominators reproduce identically ((l12+l24)/2 is IEEE-identical to 0.5*(l12+l24)).

specs.verified_mechanism: Script ChTax.py L50 inner-merges m_aCompustat (permno,gvkey,at) with m_QCompustat (gvkey,txtq) on (gvkey, time_avail_m); L62-74 builds 12-month lags via CALENDAR self-merges keyed on (gvkey, lag_time) against the merged panel (NOT positional shifts — the deviation-register text claiming 'shifts 12 ROWS' misdescribes this script); L83 ChTax=(txtq-l12_txtq)/l12_at with annual at. The engine tree DIV(DELTA(q_txt,12), LAG(at,12)) already uses the annual-at denominator and calendar lags, but lags are keyed on the PERMNO column of the wide grid while the script keys them on GVKEY. The entire residual is gvkey-permno link churn: (a) 175 value cells = permnos whose gvkey changed within 12 months — proven (55212, 1999-06): gvkey 9556@1998-06 -> 5087@1999-06; oracle = (32.6-14.6)/1388.0 = 0.0129683 differencing within CURRENT gvkey 5087 (whose 1998-06 row sat on a different permno), native = (32.6-10.742)/583.807 = 0.0374405 differencing within the permno across gvkeys (both recomputed exactly); (b) 4,867 missing-in-native = gvkey continuous but permno changed, so the engine's per-month gvkey->permno broadcast lands the t-12 txtq on the other permno's column — proven (90898, 2006-07): gvkey 147451's 2005-07 row is on permno 89396; also (60442, 1984-10): oracle 5.261e-05 = (10.197-9.796)/7622.016 using gvkey 8245's t-12 row on permno 63192; (c) 1,824 extra-in-native = engine finds lags through the permno's OLD gvkey where the script's merged panel lacks the current gvkey at t-12 — proven (75034, 2018-06): native -0.0069875 = (-86-47)/19034 using old gvkey 1976's txtq/at. m_QCompustat has 0 duplicate (gvkey,month) rows, so dedup is not a factor.

new_ops_needed.name: monthly_fastxtile_exclude
new_ops_needed.semantics: _op_monthly_fastxtile_exclude(x, key, n=5, max_excluded=2): per month (row of the wide panel), assign Stata-fastxtile buckets to key and null x where bucket <= max_excluded. Exact bucket algorithm (mirror utils/stata_fastxtile._fastxtile_core): (1) clean key: replace ±inf with NaN and values with |v| >= 1e100 with NaN; (2) valid = cleaned.notna(); if valid.sum()==0 -> all buckets NaN; (3) if valid.sum() < n -> every valid cell gets bucket 1; (4) among valid values, if nunique==1 -> all bucket 1; if nunique==2 -> min value -> bucket 1, max value -> bucket n; (5) otherwise cutpoints = pd.Series(valid_values).quantile([i/n for i in range(1,n)]) (pandas default linear interpolation) and bucket = 1 + number of cutpoints strictly less than the value (i.e. categories start at 1, value > cutpoint promotes; ties at a cutpoint stay in the lower bucket), clipped to [1,n]. Return x.where(~(bucket <= max_excluded)) so cells with NaN bucket (NaN/inf key) KEEP x — replicating the script's tempsort<=2 test being False for NaN.
